look: Heartrot Colossus, a SS-rank GKOM variant from the Eclipse Golems family: colossal rotting-wood-and-black-crystal colossus, roots and blight hanging from it. Family anatomy: constructs of black rubble and crystal assembled around a dark eclipsed orb. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: sealed in GKOM crystal except its eyes, open mouth interior and core; the crystals are black eclipse crystal with a violet rim. A basketball-sized GKOM core orb, void-black, warping light around it, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, elaborate layered shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils

If it holds a weapon in image 1, the whole weapon is clearly visible in its hand, thrust forward; otherwise it strikes with claws, horns or jaws. It still faces the left side of the picture, exactly as in image 1, and keeps hold of any weapon it carries. Only the crystal growths it has in image 1, no new ones.

segments: It holds its battle stance and breathes, shifting its weight slightly, head and tail moving a little. A subtle idle loop: it ends exactly as it began.
It performs Eclipse Crush: it lunges forward to the left and strikes hard.
It pulls back and settles into its battle stance.
It performs Core Quake: it rears up and unleashes a huge sweeping attack forward to the left.
It recovers and settles back into its battle stance.
It uses Dark Core: it rears up and swells with power.
It settles back down into its battle stance.
It performs Orb Beam: it rears and hurls its power forward to the left.
It lowers itself and returns to its battle stance.
It performs Umbral Bite: it lunges forward to the left and strikes hard.
It pulls back and settles into its battle stance.
It is struck hard and recoils backward to the right.
It shakes off the hit and recovers into its battle stance.
It hunches and braces to block.
It lowers its guard and returns to its battle stance.
It is knocked off its feet and collapses onto the ground, lying still.
It rears up and roars in triumph.
